title: Eggplant and Sweet Potato Yellow Curry
subtitle: with Steamed Rice
description: Bring silky eggplant and sweet potato together in a creamy, mild yellow curry and you've got dinner with all the delicious flavours but none of the heat.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Cut the eggplant into 2cm chunks (see Kitchen tip). Peel the sweet potato, then cut into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems, keeping them separate. Coarsely chop the peanuts. Bring 1L (4 cups) water to the boil in a medium saucepan for the rice.
Start curry: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over high heat. Cook the eggplant, sweet potato, garlic and curry paste, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer curry: Add the coconut milk and 125ml (½ cup) water to the pan and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for 15-18 mins until the sweet potato and eggplant are tender. Remove the pan from the heat.
Cook rice: Meanwhile, cook the rice in the pan of boiling water for 12 mins or until tender. Drain.

Serve up: Add the coriander stems, half the peanuts, 2 tsp soy sauce and ½ tsp white vinegar to the curry and stir to combine. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the rice and curry among bowls. Scatter over the coriander leaves and remaining peanuts and enjoy.

Kitchen tip: Only 300g (3½ cups) eggplant is needed for this recipe, so if your eggplant looks very large, you may want to check this. Either weigh it or fill a measuring jug with the chopped eggplant for a quick way to measure.
